'''Yang Hansen''' ({{lang-zh|s=杨瀚森}}; born June 26, 2005) is a Chinese professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He was drafted 16th overall by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] before being traded to the Trail Blazers. Yang is the ninth Chinese player to be drafted to the NBA, and the third highest overall to be drafted.

==Early life==
Yang was born on June 26, 2005, in [[Zibo]], [[Shandong Province]], and started playing basketball when he was a child. He joined the club for training in the third grade of elementary school and later enrolled in Zibo Sports School. Around 2020, at the invitation of Qingdao Guoxin Haitian Club, he entered the club's youth training system.<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 10, 2024 |title="中国版约基奇"杨瀚森，曾经接受大郅姚明点拨！被看好未来将会改变青岛男篮命运……-半岛网 |url=https://news.bandao.cn/a/1688985819537470.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240810211146/https://news.bandao.cn/a/1688985819537470.html |archive-date=August 10, 2024 |access-date=April 21, 2025 |language=zh}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=January 17, 2024 |title=拓宽入口与出口 发现更多杨瀚森——青岛男篮深耕青训-新华网 |url=http://www.news.cn/sports/20240117/3a52876959374ab28e249da197e6b770/c.html |access-date=April 21, 2025 |website=[[Xinhua News Agency]] |language=zh}}</ref> Additionally, after he graduated from Zibo Sports School, he enrolled in Zibo No.11 High School and participated {{ill|China High School Basketball League (CHBL)|lt=|zh|中国高中篮球联赛}}. In the 2020-21 season, he made the national tournament but was ultimately defeated in the final against [[Tsinghua University High School]].<ref name="zb11">{{cite web|url=https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20250626A0B3Y100|title=杨瀚森高中教练：他很谦虚&球商很高，训练中经常主动加练|trans-title=Yang Hansen's High School Coach: He is humble & has high basketball IQ, he always went for extra practice sessions|publisher=dongqiudi|date=26 June 2025|language=zh}}</ref>

In 2021, the Qingdao Guoxin Haitian Youth Team defeated Tsinghua High School in the finals to win the {{ill|China Youth Basketball League (CYBL)|lt=|zh|全国U系列青少年篮球联赛}} Champions for the U-17 group, and Yang was named the Best Defensive Player.<ref>{{Cite web |date=June 11, 2021 |title=创造新历史 青岛国信海天青年队取得首个U17全国冠军 |url=https://sports.sina.cn/cba/2021-06-11/detail-ikqciyzi9000373.d.html |access-date=April 21, 2025 |website=sports.sina.cn |language=zh}}</ref> In 2022, the Qingdao Guoxin Haitian Youth Team defended the U17 National Championship, and Yang was named the Most Valuable Player.<ref>{{Cite web |date=August 10, 2024 |title=7战全胜！U17青年联赛青岛队以不败战绩卫冕_CBA_新浪竞技风暴_新浪网 |url=https://sports.sina.com.cn/basketball/cba/2022-12-02/doc-imqqsmrp8376819.shtml |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240810211143/https://sports.sina.com.cn/basketball/cba/2022-12-02/doc-imqqsmrp8376819.shtml |archive-date=August 10, 2024 |access-date=April 21, 2025 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Professional career==

=== Qingdao Eagles (2023–2025) ===
During the 2023–24 [[Chinese Basketball Association|CBA]] season, Yang was promoted to the [[Qingdao Eagles]]' first team to play professional games. On October 23, 2023, he made his professional debut in the first round of the regular season against Beijing Enterprises.<ref>{{Cite web |title=国信男篮首秀惜败北控，青年军亮相亮点真不少-青报网-青岛日报官网 |url=https://www.dailyqd.com/guanhai/282683_1.html |access-date=May 7, 2025 |website=www.dailyqd.com |language=zh}}</ref> In the All-Star Game that season, Yang was selected as the starting player for the North Division Team.<ref>{{Cite web |title=杨瀚森王睿泽亮相全明星正赛，南区逆转战胜北区队胡明轩夺MVP-半岛网 |url=https://news.bandao.cn/a/1709644483765678.html |access-date=May 7, 2025 |website=news.bandao.cn |language=zh}}</ref> During his first season, NBA personnel visited the Qingdao training complex on multiple occasions to observe Yang,<ref>{{Cite web |last=腾讯网 |date=December 14, 2023 |title=规格持续升高！NBA国际球员运营主管现场考察杨瀚森，离NBA越来越近？_腾讯新闻 |url=https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20231214A06ZB600?web_channel=wap&openApp=false&suid=&media_id= |access-date=May 7, 2025 |website=news.qq.com |language=zh-CN}}</ref> but he ultimately chose not to participate in the [[2024 NBA draft]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=杨瀚森何时去NBA发展，这事到底谁说得算？-半岛网 |url=https://news.bandao.cn/a/1712318254188502.html |access-date=May 7, 2025 |website=news.bandao.cn |language=zh}}</ref> Yang was awarded both Rookie of the Year and Defensive Player of the Year honours after the season, after averaging 16.6 points, 10.5 rebounds and three assists per game.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=He |first=Fred |date=June 26, 2025 |title='Chinese Jokic' Yang Hansen selected at 16th pick at NBA draft by Portland Trail Blazers |url=https://www.cnn.com/2025/06/26/sport/yang-hansen-china-nba-blazers-intl-hnk |access-date=June 26, 2025 |website=[[CNN]] |language=en}}</ref>

=== Portland Trail Blazers (2025–present) ===
To the surprise of many,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ahmed |first=Mohamud |date=2025-06-26 |title=NBA draft: Yang Hansen – Portland Trail Blazers' Chinese 'Jokic' |website=TalkSport |url=https://talksport.com/basketball/3324155/nba-draft-yang-hansen-portland-trail-blazers-chinese-jokic/ |access-date=2025-11-10}}</ref> on June 25, 2025, Yang was selected by the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] as the 16th pick of the [[2025 NBA draft]]. However, he would later have his draft rights traded to the [[Portland Trail Blazers]], alongside future draft considerations, for the rights to [[Cedric Coward]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=June 25, 2025 |title=Trail Blazers Draft Hansen Yang 16th Overall |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2025/06/trail-blazers-draft-hansen-yang-16th-overall.html |access-date=June 26, 2025 |website=Hoops Rumors |language=en-US|last=Marshall|first=Earnest}}</ref> Yang is the [[List of foreign NBA drafted players|ninth]] Chinese player to be drafted to the NBA.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Williams |first=James H. |date=June 26, 2025 |title=Who is Yang Hansen? Meet 2025 NBA Draft pick heading to Portland Trail Blazers |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/draft/2025/06/26/yang-hansen-nba-draft-portland-trail-blazers/84364478007/ |access-date=June 28, 2025 |website=[[USA Today]] |language=en-US}}</ref> He is the highest Chinese draft pick since [[Yi Jianlian]] in 2007, and the third-highest draft pick ever from China.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Quick |first=Jason |date=June 27, 2025 |title=NBA Draft surprise: China center Yang Hansen picked at No. 16, dealt to Blazers |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/6452189/2025/06/25/nba-draft-surprise-blazers-grizzlies-yang-hansen/ |access-date=July 21, 2025 |work=[[The Athletic]] |publisher=[[The New York Times]] |language=en-US |issn=}}</ref> On Monday, January 26, 2026, the NBA announced that Hansen, along with [[Donovan Clingan]], were both announced to be players for the [[Rising Stars game]].<ref name="nba-clingan-hansen-risingstars">{{Cite web
 |title=Clingan and Hansen to Face Off in 2026 Rising Stars at All-Star Weekend
 |url=https://www.nba.com/blazers/news/clingan-and-hansen-to-face-off-in-2026-rising-stars-at-all-star-weekend
 |access-date=2026-01-06
 |website=[[NBA.com]]
 |language=en-US
}}</ref> In his rookie season, Yang was [[NBA salary cap|assigned]] to the [[Rip City Remix]]<ref>{{cite web
 |last=Musumeci
 |first=Jamie
 |date=November 1, 2025
 |title=Yang Hansen Assigned to G League With Rip City Remix
 |website=Heavy
 |url=https://www.heavy.com/sports/nba/portland-trail-blazers/yang-hansen-g-league-assignment/
 |access-date=November 2, 2025
}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=RotoWire Staff |first= |date=2025-11-13 |title=Trail Blazers' Yang Hansen: Assigned to G League |website=CBS Sports |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/trail-blazers-yang-hansen-assigned-to-g-league/ |access-date=2025-11-13}}</ref> but was subsequently recalled back to the Portland Trail Blazers.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-15 |title=Trail Blazers' Yang Hansen: Recalled to NBA |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/trail-blazers-yang-hansen-recalled-to-nba/ |access-date=2026-01-04 |website=CBS Sports |language=en}}</ref>

==National team career==
Yang represented [[China men's national under-19 basketball team|China]] at the [[2023 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup]], averaging 12.6 points, 10.4 rebounds (3rd highest in the tournament), 4.7 assists (4th highest in the tournament) and five blocks (highest in the tournament), and was named in the [[2023 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup#Awards|All-Second Team]].<ref>{{Cite news |title=杨瀚森打出全能数据，入选U19世界杯最佳二阵 |url=https://www.bjnews.com.cn/detail/1688367783169120.html |access-date=May 20, 2025 |website=[[The Beijing News]] |language=zh}}</ref>

In February 2024, he made his [[China men's national basketball team|national team]] debut in the [[2025 FIBA Asia Cup qualification|2025 FIBA Asian Cup qualifiers]] against [[Mongolia men's national basketball team|Mongolia]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=February 23, 2024 |title=男篮亚预赛：中国队80:49战胜蒙古国队 |url=https://www.chinanews.com.cn/ty/2024/02-23/10168111.shtml |access-date=May 20, 2025 |publisher=[[China News Service]] |language=zh}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Yang Hansen's father, Yang Lin, is an [[electrician]] and an amateur basketball player. Yang's mother, Zhu Jing, is an accountant.<ref>{{cite news |last=Golliver |first=Ben |title=No joke: Chinese rookie Yang Hansen is the NBA's biggest summer star |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/2025/07/20/yang-hansen-trail-blazers-nba/ |work=[[The Washington Post]] |date=July 20, 2025 |access-date=September 16, 2025}}</ref> Additionally, Yang Hansen has stated that he likes to sleep, eat and play video games on his [[PlayStation 5]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Trail Blazers introduce rookie Yang Hansen |url=https://www.nba.com/news/trail-blazers-yang-hansen-introduced |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=August 19, 2025|date=June 27, 2025|agency=The Associated Press}}</ref>
